title: kithctl watch fires notification storm on every restart
description: watch.rs cmd_watch initializes last_message_state to 's-0' on every process start (line 607). On restart, watch fetches all messages since s-0 and fires a desktop notification for each. With many messages this is a notification storm. The state token is not persisted between invocations. Fix: persist last_message_state to a file in config.data_dir, or initialize from a current-state endpoint call.
